question: What claim about the agent of transmission is at stake in saying that the teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: The teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
The address is to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was transmitted by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Of the earth-moving good-eaters, by the earth-mover it was told, O beloved one.
